name: Tidebound Constant
source:
Following your grandfather's passing, you spend the summer caring for his isolated lighthouse on a fog covered coastline.

Disturbing logbook entries hint at previous keepers who became obsessed with something lurking beneath the waves. Strange memories surface without explanation. The lighthouse itself feels oddly familiar, as though you've walked its halls before.

Then, one evening, someone calls your name from the ocean.

As forgotten memories begin to resurface, you'll have to uncover the truth behind your connection before history repeats itself once again. 

[From [url=https://mookichuu.itch.io/tidebound-constant]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
祖父去世后，你整个夏天都在雾气弥漫的海岸线上照顾他孤零零的灯塔。

令人不安的日志条目暗示了以前的饲养员对潜伏在海浪下的东西着迷。奇怪的记忆浮现出来，没有任何解释。灯塔本身给人一种奇怪的熟悉感，就好像你以前走过它的大厅一样。

然后，一天晚上，有人从海上呼唤你的名字。

随着被遗忘的记忆开始重新浮现，你必须在历史再次重演之前揭开你们联系背后的真相。

[来自[url=https://mookichuu.itch.io/tidebound-constant]itch.io[/url]]
